title: TDMA u32 overflow in slot_start product; init passes epoch where spec wants SFN
description: File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tdma.c:117,29,103. superframe*n_slots*d wraps mod 2^32 for large SFN producing inverted/non-monotonic windows; lichen_tdma_init and lichen_link_set_slot pass ctx->epoch as SFN arg of lichen_tdma_compute_slot while spec/02a section 2a.4 defines Slot=(fnv1a32(EUI64)+u32(SFN)) mod n over beacon SFN. Pre-existing, elevated now tdma.c is canonical. Fix: 64-bit intermediates/frame-relative phase; wire real beacon SFN; wrap vectors.
close_reason: Fixed: (1) tdma_tx_allowed schedule product widened to u64 intermediates with explicit mod-2^32 reduction per spec/02a 2a.2 unsigned rule (exact homomorphic reduction, kyn9 modular contract preserved bit-for-bit); (2) lichen_tdma_init and set_slot sentinel path no longer substitute key-rotation ctx->epoch for beacon SFN - init uses SFN-0 baseline, sentinel derives from the sfn argument per 2a.2 Slot=(fnv1a32(EUI64)+u32(SFN)) mod n. Battery extended: Case D first-product-overflow SFN=2147484 (start mod 2^32 = 1954, window [1954,2104) hand-computed), Case E sentinel derivation pinned to ccp_sfn_wrap_slot_hash.json (sfn=1,n=16->14; sfn=FFFFFFFF,n=3->2). Verified: clang -fsyntax-only tdma.c OK; real tdma.c+link_ctx.c+tx_queue.c ASan/UBSan harness green incl. all kyn9 A-C cases; python TDMAScheduler/slot_for equivalence PASS (13 hash vectors + 24 timing probes, same-frame domain); cppcheck clean. Discovered-and-filed enyo: pre-existing (HEAD) main.c schnorr48 call-site arity breakage outside scope.
